records.quote:
The more kids, the more
there are to grow up to beget more kids, ad infinitum till something
gives.
records.paraphrase: Justin extrapolates unchecked population growth leading to eventual collapse.

records.quote:
a life expectancy at birth of
sixty-eight years; a daily diet of three thousand calories; meat, eggs,
milk whenever you wished (why, he himself could scarcely remember the
taste of beef!); bountiful super-markets groaning with viands
records.paraphrase: The narrative contrasts the abundance of the past era with the deprivation of the present.

records.quote:
What science has known for
years is that it's the condition of the child in the womb during the
first three months of pregnancy that regulates size. I developed a
simple injection and diet
records.paraphrase: Justin explains prenatal size regulation and his injection-and-diet technique to induce dwarfing before birth.

records.quote:
They took 'em
all and threw 'em together with automation. For better production,
they claimed. Nobody's allowed back but the damned button-pushers.
records.paraphrase: Farms have been seized and consolidated under automation, displacing rural populations.

records.quote:
Riots, the worst in thirty years, swept the nation late today in the
wake of President Austin's stunning message to Congress. The Federal
Building in St. Louis is burning.
records.paraphrase: Nationwide riots erupt after the President announces the space program's failure.

records.quote: in two generations anyone over three feet tall would be the exception.
records.paraphrase: Justin projects that prenatal dwarfing applied broadly would make tall people rare within two generations.

records.quote:
He told Congress he has ordered abandonment of the
Moon stations. He also has ordered immediate dismantlement of all
rocket-launching installations, the closing of rocket-building yards,
and the complete cessation of all Space research.
records.paraphrase: The government abandons the entire space program and dismantles its infrastructure.

records.quote: "You practiced on my niece? You cold-blooded louse!"
records.paraphrase: Hackett reacts with anger on learning Justin experimented on his pregnant niece.

records.quote:
Nobody denied that in this year of Our Lord, 2060, a new frontier was
needed to relieve the horrible overcrowding.
records.paraphrase: The story is set in 2060 amid severe overcrowding requiring a new frontier.

records.quote: "It's a dwarf, I tell you! Oh Justin, how could you?"
records.paraphrase: Doris reacts with horror upon realizing her baby is intentionally a dwarf.

records.quote:
the frantic
expenditure of capital without return could only end in complete
bankruptcy.
records.paraphrase: Economic collapse resulted from wasteful spending on the space program.

records.quote:
if we stop the growth,
right now, of the thirty million in
that age group, allowing for natural mortality, in twenty years we'll
have over two hundred million small people--a fifth of our number.
records.paraphrase: Justin projects the demographic outcome of applying dwarfing to young children over twenty years.

records.quote:
What the early endocrinologists found was that a deficiency of
growth hormone in the anterior lobe of the pituitary gland caused the
condition. They corrected it by injecting the right pituitary extracts
so the midgets grew normally.
records.paraphrase: The mechanism of dwarfism via pituitary growth hormone deficiency and its correction is explained.

records.quote:
what I've done is merely reverse the process by a proper
manipulation of glandular balance. It's nothing they couldn't have done
a century ago. And there's your result: a new and better breed of human
in which nothing is omitted but size.
records.paraphrase: Justin explains he reversed the hormonal process to deliberately create small but otherwise normal humans.

records.quote: "It's a new creation," he said.
records.paraphrase: Justin proudly declares his miniaturized newborn a new kind of human.

records.quote:
When I took
them from various welfare bureaus, their average age was eighteen
months. The girls' average height was thirty-one inches, the boys a
trifle more. Well, that's still their height, but they are now twenty
years old.
records.paraphrase: Justin describes his experimental subjects and measured outcomes of the dwarfing procedure.

records.quote:
the nation in the decade after the
Red collapse had poured half her national income into those innumerable
stabs toward the stars.
records.paraphrase: The nation spent half its income on the space race, described as the cause of decline.

records.quote:
Crazy, this young girl latching onto the habit forty-odd years after
they'd switched the last Burley field to essential food grains.
records.paraphrase: Tobacco farming was abolished and land converted to food grains, and smoking is prohibited.

records.quote:
As workers, these little people can produce as much
as normal adults. Yet they need only half the food and yardage in
clothes, smaller houses, smaller everything. Think of the tremendous
savings in natural resources!
records.paraphrase: Justin projects that miniaturized humans would use far fewer resources while remaining productive.

records.quote:
By 2030 the last foundations for any industrial nation collapsed
as increasing man--cancer on his own planet, spendthrift and
wastrel--exhausted his oil and coal and gas and minerals.
records.paraphrase: By 2030 industrial civilization collapsed as natural resources were exhausted.

records.quote:
the National Demographic Authority, the agency
which--in view of the galloping population crisis--had long since
succeeded the Security Council as No. 1 pusher-around of people.
records.paraphrase: A demographic control agency has replaced the Security Council as the dominant governing body due to population crisis.

criteria.rationale: Real endocrinology (pituitary growth hormone, prenatal size regulation) is materially represented and reworked as speculative science central to the plot's central premise.
Justin's engineered injection-and-diet technique for artificial dwarfing is an invention that drives the entire problem, action, and outcome of the story.
The story is explicitly set in 2060, a speculative future, with a developed historical timeline of decline; no time travel but future setting is material.

The narrative systematically extrapolates consequences from the identifiable premise of unchecked overpopulation and resource depletion, projecting demographic and economic outcomes across generations.

Justin conducts long-term experiments with measured height/age outcomes and reversed a known biological process, suggesting systematic inference; but the process is reported retrospectively rather than shown as hypothesis-test-revision driving understanding, leaving materiality uncertain.
Space, Moon stations, and Mars are mentioned only as a failed program and abandoned aspiration; no other place or visitor is materially depicted or entered in the narrative.
The remembered civilizational collapse by 2030 from resource exhaustion and economic bankruptcy, plus the actual nationwide riots, constitute a large-scale, causally central catastrophe.

candidates.description: A biochemical technique of glandular/hormonal manipulation (postnatal injection-and-diet and prenatal injection-and-diet) that deliberately produces fully healthy, high-IQ, proportionate but miniaturized humans, proposed as a species-wide solution to overpopulation and resource exhaustion.

novelty.rationale: The candidate constitutes a totalizing difference from the empirical norm: deliberate creation of a new, permanently miniaturized breed of human intended to be adopted as universal prenatal care, such that within two generations anyone over three feet would be the exception. This world-altering reengineering of the human species is a qualitative departure from any real-world norm.

cognitive_validation.rationale: The story offers a coherent, immanent, nonsupernatural account grounded in imaginary endocrinology: pituitary growth-hormone deficiency causes dwarfism; the process is 'reversed' by glandular manipulation; and prenatal size is regulated in the first trimester. Empirical accuracy is not required; the systematic biochemical logic and reported experimental subjects supply cognitive validation.

narrative_hegemony.rationale: The dwarfing technique governs the overriding narrative logic: it is Justin's secret answer to the overpopulation crisis, the political fulcrum for reelecting Austin and enlisting the Bosses, the object of Doris's pregnancy experiment, and the climactic 'new creation' that ends the story. The entire plot converges on this novum.

estrangement.rationale: Reader estrangement arises from contrasting the remembered abundance of the past with the deprived present, then presenting deliberate human miniaturization as salvation. Character reactions (Hackett's outrage, Doris's horror, Justin's pride) dramatize the moral and cognitive shock of the novum, though character surprise is not required for qualification.

candidates.description: A 2060 storyworld defined by galloping global overpopulation (ten billion) and civilizational/economic collapse, with a National Demographic Authority governing, farms consolidated under automation, and tobacco abolished.

novelty.rationale: The Malthusian-collapse setting is a totalizing world condition differing sharply from the empirical norm, altering governance, food, land, and daily life.

cognitive_validation.rationale: A coherent extrapolative socioeconomic logic is supplied: unchecked population growth plus wasteful capital expenditure on space leads to bankruptcy and resource exhaustion.

narrative_hegemony.rationale: The overpopulation collapse is the pervasive backdrop and motivation, but it functions as the condition the narrative responds to rather than the difference that governs the plot's resolution; the dwarfing novum is the operative driver. Its hegemony is thus ambiguous relative to the dominant novum.

estrangement.rationale: The stark contrast between the remembered era of plenty and present-day rationing, disease, and crowding estranges the reader by extrapolating current demographic anxieties to a totalizing crisis.

candidates.description: A decades-long, income-consuming space colonization program (Moon stations, Mars landing) that is officially declared a failure and dismantled, triggering nationwide riots.

novelty.rationale: Established interplanetary infrastructure and its collapse represent a differing storyworld condition, though it is presented as backstory that has failed rather than an operative marvel.

cognitive_validation.rationale: The program and its ruinous economics are given a coherent immanent account of capital expenditure without return leading to bankruptcy.

narrative_hegemony.rationale: The space program's failure is a catastrophic plot event that clears the ground for the dwarfing solution, but it does not itself determine the overriding narrative logic; it is an antecedent whose function is to make Justin's novum the story's answer. It thus lacks controlling centrality.

estrangement.rationale: The abandonment of the space dream and resulting riots and suicides estrange the reader by inverting the optimistic frontier trope, but this operates as a subordinate catastrophe rather than the governing cognitive difference.
